AP Research.text: 🔎 AP Research Humanities · Portfolio-only — no written exam Pass rate 90% scored 3 or higher Portfolio component Weight 100% of final score Deadline Fri, Apr 30, 2027 Academic paper (4,000–5,000 words, 75%) submitted as final in the AP Digital Portfolio by 11:59 p.m. ET; presentation and oral defense (25%) are teacher-scored.
